BESTIARY_SOURCE: Animal Bestiary (mordheimer.net, as kept in the project's docs): animals and creatures for leaders' opponent profiles only – not hirable through these entries, not a warband's equipment.

BESTIARY.name: Wardog
rules: Never gains experience; put out of action, it recovers like a Henchman (1–2 dead, 3–6 alive).

In battle it behaves like any other warrior, Rout tests included; in the campaign it is equipment, so no upkeep. It counts towards the warband's maximum size (noted as unclear on mordheimer.net). After Tuomas Pirinen.

BESTIARY.name: Gnoblar Fighter
BESTIARY.equipment: Dagger and sharp stuff (thrown weapon: S2, range 8", fires twice)
rules: Counts towards the number of warriors but not for Rout tests – neither for the warband's size nor as lost models.
At the start of the turn roll a D6 for each Gnoblar within 2" of another and not in close combat: on a 1 it bickers and does nothing else this turn.
Counts as a Greenskin but does not suffer from Animosity. Not an animal.

BESTIARY.name: Chaos Steed
rules: May not be ridden by The Possessed
Even Chaos Steeds will not carry a Possessed.
The rider may re-roll a failed loss of control test (one re-roll per test).

BESTIARY.name: Cold One
rules: Test against the rider's Leadership each turn; if failed, the usual stupidity applies.
+1 armour save bonus for the rider (+2 in total).

BESTIARY.name: Elven Steed
rules: The rider may re-roll a failed loss of control test (one re-roll per test).

BESTIARY.name: Giant Spider
rules: Its attacks count as Strength 4, without modifying armour saves.
Walks up and down walls without Initiative tests; jumps at most 2" across or down (a diving charge); the rider tests Initiative when it jumps or rolls on Whoa Boy!

BESTIARY.name: Mule
rules: A rider, or a warrior in base contact, tests Leadership each round or the mule refuses to move.
Without rider or leader it wanders in a random direction; bolts away from any close combat within 6".
Does not fight and cannot charge; charged with a rider, roll on Whoa Boy!; charged without one, it bolts away.

BESTIARY.name: Nightmare
rules: May not run, but may charge.
Never takes Leadership tests; stands still without a leader. A wounded rider still rolls on Whoa Boy!

BESTIARY.name: Rhinox
rules: With an enemy it could charge, the rider must pass a Leadership test or declare a charge.
Charging more than 7", it causes D3 impact hits at its own Strength.
Knocked down instead loses 1 Attack until its next Recovery phase (several results, several Attacks).

BESTIARY.name: Riding Horse
BESTIARY.src: Mordheim Rulebook (WS 1 from Border Town Burning)
rules: Will not normally attack; useful for moving quickly.

BESTIARY.name: Temple Dog
rules: Armour save 5+, not modified by Strength or other save modifiers.
All its attacks count as magical.
Knocked down instead loses 1 Attack until its next Recovery phase (several results, several Attacks).

BESTIARY.name: War Boar
rules: +2 Strength when charging (the boar only, not the rider).
+1 armour save bonus for the rider (+2 in total).

BESTIARY.name: Warhorse
rules: The rider may re-roll a failed loss of control test (one re-roll per test).
